dayPrompt: Use case: compositing / canvas expansion. Edit target: supplied existing generated daytime SALAH panorama. Create a dedicated FULL-BLEED VERTICAL PHONE WALLPAPER, target 853x1844 pixels, aspect ratio 0.4626 (about 9:19.5). The user's problem: a landscape image was enlarged to fill a tall phone, cutting away all the side architecture and the beautiful context. Solve it by preserving the ENTIRE LEFT-TO-RIGHT ORIGINAL PANORAMA in this vertical artwork at its correct proportions, then extending natural sky ABOVE and natural ground BELOW. Do NOT center-crop, do NOT magnify the landmark, do NOT narrow the architecture, do NOT stretch. Zoom out enough that ALL original peripheral buildings, minarets, trees and the courtyard remain visible with 6% left/right breathing room. Put the original whole view across approximately the lower-middle 42–78% of the tall frame, with expansive quiet daylight sky above and continuing realistic foreground below. The original panorama should occupy about 88% of the final width, integrated naturally, no visible rectangular inserted photo, no frames, no seams, no letterbox or plain-color bands. Faithfully preserve original named real landmark, every dome color, architectural proportions, camera perspective and major details; extend only matching sky and ground. Tactile realistic editorial photography, calm natural light and subtle airy depth, high image quality. No overlay text, no logos, no drawn Sun or Moon (the app adds them), no new buildings, no fantasy structures, no invented calligraphy or faces. Leave generous margins around EVERYTHING: the finished phone should reveal the panorama, not a close-up.
nightPrompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: supplied SALAH daytime wallpaper. Change ONLY time of day and ambient lighting to beautiful natural deep blue night. Preserve EXACT camera position, canvas ratio and dimensions, horizon, framing, physical shapes, coordinates, every building/dome/minaret/arch/Kaaba edge and the terrain. No camera movement, no resize, no new objects. Keep the named landmark completely unchanged and just relight it. A midnight indigo sky with very faint cloud texture; NO visible astronomical Moon or Sun, no star spray (the app overlays celestial bodies). Authentic restrained warm lighting on built structures if present, soft cool moonless ambient light and subtle rock visibility for the mountain. No invented neon outlines, no fantasy glowing golden dome, no text overlay or new lettering, no watermark. The Kaaba must remain black, Medina's dome GREEN, Al-Aqsa's dome grey, Mount Uhud red-brown. Do not add/remove pilgrims, umbrellas, columns, trees or architectural details. Night counterpart precisely aligned with day for a smooth opacity crossfade. Full bleed to all edges.
